headlines.title: South Carolina Senate rivals spar over Iran, AI and Trump in debate
headlines.description: Annie Andrews and Darline Graham are running to replace the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, and the winner will make history as the first female senator elected from South Carolina.

headlines.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's home in ongoing criminal probe
headlines.description: Federal agents conducted a search at the home of of Rep. Ilhan Omar, D-Minn., as part as an ongoing criminal probe. NBC News' Ryan Reilly has the early details on the investigation and the unusual timing of the action this close to an election.

headlines.title: Trump Faces Intense Bipartisan Backlash Over Russian Oil Deal
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is facing growing bipartisan backlash following his announcement of a deal to temporarily lift U.S. sanctions on Russian diesel fuel. The move, aimed at lowering fuel prices in the United States ahead of the midterm elections, has members of Congress from both parties saying the deal may be illegal. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh Airport Hit With 2 Strikes in 2 Days
headlines.description: Videos show the moments Riyadh Airport, the main airport in Saudi Arabia, was hit in a deadly attack on Saturday and then again on Sunday, killing more than a dozen including one American. Now questions swirl about whether the United States will join airstrikes against the Iranian-backed Houthi militants responsible for the attacks, which would widen the U.S.-Iran conflict just weeks before the midterm elections. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Starbucks is ‘not buying Chipotle’ after report it had explored a deal
headlines.description: Starbucks said that it would not be moving to buy Chipotle Mexican Grill, after a report days earlier said the coffeehouse chain had evaluated the prospect.

headlines.title: Kelly Clarkson Has Her Own ‘Pretty Woman’ Moment at NY Store
headlines.description: Kelly Clarkson is accusing a Brooklyn store of mistreatment after an alleged encounter at novelty shop, Art of Play, sharing on social media that the sales associate was “rude” to her when she inquired about a $15,000 item, with Clarkson comparing the moment to a famous scene from “Pretty Woman.”

headlines.title: NFL Week 5: Don’t count out Aaron Rodgers and Drake Maye just yet
headlines.description: Plus, three undefeated and three winless teams remain after a week of bizarre endings and bounce-back performances.

headlines.title: In new Elon Musk documentary, his lieutenants are the most damning voices
headlines.description: ‘Musk,’ the new film from Alex Gibney, features interviews with more than the usual critics of the Tesla and SpaceX CEO.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: Coast-to-coast cleanup after three storms batter North America
headlines.description: North Americans are dealing with the aftermath of three storms that battered the continent’s coasts this weekend.

headlines.title: Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home searched by federal agents in criminal probe
headlines.description: Federal agents searched Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home in Washington, D.C., on Monday morning, according to two people familiar with the investigation.

headlines.title: Deadly Saudi airport strikes mark major Mideast escalation
headlines.description: Fears of intensifying conflict were growing in Saudi Arabia on Monday after Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis launched multiple strikes on Riyadh’s airport over the weekend, killing 13 people and wounding hundreds.
